title: Small and flimsy
text: Small and flimsy. I purchased three of these for my grandkids for Christmas.  They are quite small.  I wouldn't order this for any child over three.  It ended up being much to small for my six year old granddaughter.

product_metadata.title: Marshmallow Furniture, Children's 2-in-1 Flip Open Foam Compressed Sofa, Moana
features: COMFY FOAM TODDLER COUCH: Give your little one their own exclusive lounging sofa with this perfectly sized compact flip-open couch with a fun & colorful design crafted from durable and comfy foam.
EASY TO UNBOX: Sofa ships compressed in an airtight compact box. Remove from packaging & watch it grow! Please allow up to 24 hours for compressed foam sofa to return to its full size & shape.
2-IN-1 SOFA & SLEEPER BED: Innovative flip-open construction combines couch & sleeper bed for lounging, sitting, & napping. Sofa dimensions: 14.75"h, 29.25"w, and 16”d. Flips open to a 3ft lounger.
AGES 18 MONTHS AND UP: Recommended for kids ages 18 months and up with a 100 pound weight capacity and one child seating capacity.
MACHINE WASHABLE COVER: Polyester fabric slipcover features a safety zipper without the traditional zipper pull and is machine washable
Covered by the Spin Master Care Commitment. See below for full details
